description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. Wolt’s Courier Operations team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet - a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.

The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks.
